subject: Northshore security sprint: SOC2, pen-test & retention checklist
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Claire Summers <claire.summers@northshorebank.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@northshorebank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Northshore security sprint: SOC2, pen-test & retention checklist

Hi Claire / Raj —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan for the security onboarding sprint. High-level goal: get Northshore comfortable to start a late-July pilot by delivering the artifacts procurement needs and verifying retention/audit-log capabilities.

What we heard (priority order)
- SOC 2 Type II evidence and summary of controls (procurement/legal asks for attestation + scope).
- Audit log exports with per-request metadata (requestor, path, timestamp, IP, model/version) and a retention guarantee (you mentioned 3 years with tiered access).
- Pen-test artifacts or a vendor-accepted equivalent demonstrating remediation timelines (you prefer vendor-agnostic evidence).
- DPA redline + clarity on subprocessor list and logging retention carveouts.

Immediate risks / constraints we flagged
- Some logs include request payloads; we need to confirm masking/PII redaction options for audit exports to meet privacy policy.
- Long retention increases storage and egress costs — we proposed tiered retention (hot 90d, archival 3y) and quota-based access for legal/audit.

What Redwood will deliver this week (proposed timeline)
1) Today/Tomorrow: SOC2 summary PDF and control mapping to your questionnaire — Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf.
2) 48 hours: small sample audit-log export (redacted) showing fields + JSON schema — Attachment: auditlog-sample.json.
3) By Tuesday EOD: first-pass DPA redline focusing on retention & audit log access — Attachment: dpa-draft-redline.docx.
4) Within 5 business days: pen-test scope & ops notes (what we can share without violating vendor agreements) — Attachment: pen-test-ops-scope.xlsx.

Proposed next meetings
- Technical deep-dive (logs & masking): 60m call with your infra/devops and our infra lead (Rishi) — suggested slots: Tue 10–12 PT or Wed 14–16 PT.
- Legal/DPA sync: 30m with your legal counsel + our contracts lead (Marissa).

Action items / owners (so we close the loop)
- Kimberly (me): deliver SOC2 summary + DPA redline.
- Rishi: prepare sample audit-log export and run quick retention cost estimate.
- Marissa: prep DPA talking points and escalation path for any required exceptions.

Claire / Raj — can you confirm: (a) the retention requirement is 3 years for audit logs (hot vs archive), (b) who from your privacy/legal team should be on the DPA sync, and (c) preferred time for the technical deep-dive?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this sprint started.

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0129
Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM serving

- auditlog-sample.json (JSON, redacted sample)

- pen-test-ops-scope.xlsx (Excel, ops-level scope)

From: Claire Summers <claire.summers@northshorebank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@northshorebank.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northshore security sprint: SOC2, pen-test & retention checklist

Kimberly — thanks for the clear write-up. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Priorities: SOC2 summary is the primary procurement blocker; audit logs are second; DPA redline and pen-test artifacts are tied but lower priority if we have remediation timelines documented.
2) Retention: yes — we need a 3-year retention guarantee for audit logs, but access levels matter. Legal requests full export for investigations; product teams want searchability on hot data (90 days). If you can offer tiered access (hot/archive) with an SLA for retrieval from archive that would be ideal.
3) Pen-test: we prefer a vendor-agnostic summary that lists findings and remediation windows (e.g., critical/30d, high/60d). Providing a redacted findings summary is fine; we don't need raw reports.
4) Privacy contact: loop in Megan Holt (megan.holt@northshorebank.com) from Privacy & Data Governance for the DPA sync.

Technical deep-dive: Tue 13 Jun, 10:30–11:30 PT (we'll hold that slot pending confirmation).

Thanks — Claire

Kim / Marissa — quick internal alignment after Claire's reply: 

- Confirmed items: SOC2 summary first; retention 3 years (hot 90d + archive 3y) with retrieval SLA.
- Action plan (Rishi owner unless noted):
  * Today: upload SOC2 summary + control mapping to shared drive. (Done — link in related_links).
  * Tomorrow: generate redacted audit-log sample. I'll coordinate with infra to mask payloads per privacy guidance (PII removal).
  * Tue: DPA redline (Marissa owner) — focus on retention carveouts and subprocessor visibility. I'll pre-seed a retention appendix describing tiered storage + estimated monthly costs for 3y.
  * Pen-test: reach out to our 3rd-party ops vendor to produce a findings summary with remediations; expect initial summary in ~3 business days.

Risks to highlight to the customer: long-term retention will need a billing tier or committed storage SKU for Dedicated/Private customers; for hosted customers we'll propose a managed archive add-on.

I'll draft the technical deep-dive agenda before Tue and include sample log schema + redaction checklist.
